attempts.sql: SELECT * FROM calculation_result_attempt WHERE logical_run_id=$1 ORDER BY attempt_no

finalFull.mode: Same predicates and ordering as each critical query, SELECT * once at end; post-observation persistence evidence, not an earlier SLO witness

firstCompleteFull.mode: First terminal-or-later observation with actual bootstrap ID sets and current-window record references complete: SELECT * all four arrays in that same RR transaction; no product gate/status/version decision

firstTerminalFull.mode: First terminal checkpoint observation: SELECT * ledger/latest/nodes/records inside that same RR transaction, retain even if partial

latest.sql: SELECT id,loop_id,data_ts_start,data_ts_end,status,score,algorithm_version,updated_at,result_record_id FROM loop_confidence_latest WHERE loop_id=ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY loop_id

ledger.sql: SELECT id,loop_id,ts_start,ts_end,score,status,algorithm_version,fitness_tags,fitness_detail,source,source_task_id,result_record_id FROM kpi_snapshot_hourly WHERE ts_start=$1 AND loop_id=ANY($2::uuid[]) ORDER BY loop_id

nodes.sql: SELECT id,plant_node_id,ts_start,ts_end,score,status,algorithm_version,created_at,result_record_id FROM kpi_node_snapshot_hourly WHERE ts_start=$1 AND plant_node_id=ANY($2::uuid[]) ORDER BY plant_node_id

records.sql: SELECT id,logical_run_id,object_kind,object_id,ts_start,ts_end,source_record_id,algorithm_version,config_revision,status,created_at,payload->'fitness_tags' AS payload_fitness_tags,payload->>'snapshotStatus' AS payload_snapshot_status,payload->'loopRecordIds' AS payload_loop_record_ids FROM calculation_result_record WHERE id=ANY($1::uuid[]) OR ($2::uuid IS NOT NULL AND logical_run_id=$2::uuid AND ts_start=$3) ORDER BY object_kind,object_id,id

transaction: REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; each completed observation has one snapshot ID, no result mutations
